rulingTitle: The migration-backed test has not passed outside the sandbox, and US-001 still lacks the required pre-implementation failing-test evidence.

action.reason: Migration-backed US-001 spec has never run against real Postgres; skipped sandbox runs are not verification per the PRD. A human must run it on host Postgres (KODA_DB_TESTS=1, outside sandbox), record the result, and decide whether to excuse the historical TDD-order deviation.

rationale: No spec-backed or scope-backed reason to waive unverified migration and repository behavior; holding is reversible and cheap to clear.

rulingTitle: Both cancellation commit/rollback cases remain skipped, so PostgreSQL verification is still outstanding.

action.reason: The cancel-job commit/rollback cases are the real-DB rollback assertions for approved-path atomicity and remain skipped. They must run outside the sandbox against provisioned test Postgres with passing results recorded; the PRD forbids counting skips as verification.

rationale: Skipped tests give no evidence the rollback guarantee holds; waiving would ship it unverified.
